reason: The EventProof DSL provided has no DWELL/event type or event value capable of representing a complete stop (zero speed / stationary state). The available event schema shown for nodes only supports CROSSES with a line and direction; there is no line in the scene and no stop/speed-threshold event field in the allowed node schema. Therefore a complete-stop requirement cannot be faithfully compiled without inventing an unsupported event type or geometry.
text: Every vehicle must come to a complete stop.
